questions.prompt: What is the value of the digit 7 in 571,284?

questions.prompt: A baker places 96 rolls equally on 8 trays. How many rolls are on each tray?
questions.explanation: Ninety-six divided by eight equals 12.

questions.prompt: Which fraction is smallest?

questions.explanation: Width is area divided by length: 48 ÷ 8 = 6 cm.

questions.prompt: Which pair of lines will never meet, even if extended?
questions.explanation: Parallel lines remain the same distance apart and never meet.

questions.prompt: Mira spends two fifths of $85. How much money remains?
questions.explanation: Two fifths of 85 is 34, so 85 − 34 = 51 remains.

questions.prompt: A crate has 16 layers of 15 oranges. How many oranges are in the crate?
questions.explanation: Sixteen times 15 is 240.

questions.prompt: Which expression has the same value as 84 ÷ 6?

questions.prompt: Which unit is best for measuring water in a bath?
questions.explanation: A bath holds a large liquid volume, so litres are suitable.

questions.prompt: Three consecutive whole numbers total 192. What is the middle number?
questions.explanation: The middle of three consecutive numbers is their mean: 192 ÷ 3 = 64.
